row.title: Record on main by merge, never rebase
row.body: Workflows that record data on main must not git pull --rebase (it stops on generated claim blocks in README.md, deploy-workers run 44927206546); use tools/record_main.sh: merge main, resolve_generated, claims --fix, push_main. Guarded by tests/foundation/test_record_main.py. New source files need the SPDX header (failmine.py and probes/mergeaudit.py lacked it and turned the foundation tests red).
